title: Large Reward Models: Generalizable Online Robot Reward Generation with Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.16065v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown strong potential for improving robotic manipulation policies, yet its practical use remains bottlenecked by the difficulty of specifying reward functions that are both semantically meaningful and reusable across tasks. In this paper, we propose Large Reward Models (LRMs), a framework that adapts foundation VLMs into frame-level reward generators for robot policy refinement. We specialize a state-of-the-art VLM on a multi-source dataset spanning real-world robot trajectories, human-object interactions, and simulated manipulation environments. Unlike prior approaches that mainly evaluate trajectories post-hoc, LRMs expose multiple reward interfaces from visual observations: progress estimation, task completion, and temporal contrastive comparison. Starting from an imitation-learned policy, we use these VLM-derived rewards to guide PPO refinement on held-out long-horizon manipulation tasks. Ou

translated_title: 大型奖励模型：基于视觉-语言模型的泛化在线机器人奖励生成
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）在改进机器人操作策略方面展现出强大潜力，但其实际应用仍然受到瓶颈限制，即难以定义既具有语义意义又可在不同任务间复用的奖励函数。在本文中，我们提出了大型奖励模型，这是一个将基础视觉-语言模型改造为帧级奖励生成器、用于优化机器人策略的框架。我们在一个涵盖真实世界机器人轨迹、人-物交互以及仿真操作环境的多源数据集上，对一个最先进的视觉-语言模型进行了专门化训练。与以往主要事后评估轨迹的方法不同，LRMs 从视觉观察中提供多种奖励接口：进度估计、任务完成判定以及时间对比比较。从模仿学习得到的策略出发，我们利用这些由 VLM 导出的奖励，引导 PPO 在留出的长时程操作任务上进行策略优化。
tldr: 提出了大型奖励模型（LRMs），将视觉-语言模型专门化为帧级奖励生成器，提供进度估计、任务完成和时间对比等多种奖励接口，从而利用 PPO 优化模仿学习策略并泛化到长时程机器人操作任务。
en_tdlr: Proposes Large Reward Models (LRMs) that adapt vision-language models into frame-level reward generators with multiple reward interfaces, enabling PPO-based refinement of imitation-learned robot policies on long-horizon manipulation tasks.
